name: Animated Testimonials
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line behaviour description only; no 21st.dev source was fetched or read, so no MIT attribution is owed, and framer-motion is replaced by CSS keyframes plus a few lines of dependency-free script.

autoplay.description: Step to the next testimonial on a timer.

interval.description: Time between autoplay steps, in ms.

wordStagger.description: Delay between each revealed word, in ms.

pauseOnHover.description: Pause autoplay while the pointer is over the component; keyboard focus always pauses it.

a11y: Each quote is read once: its original nodes move into a visually-hidden span and the animated word spans are aria-hidden.
Inactive testimonials are visibility:hidden, so screen readers and the tab order only reach the one on show.
Previous and Next are real buttons with aria-labels; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight also step while focus is inside, and manual steps are announced through a polite live region.
Autoplay pauses on hover, on keyboard focus, in a hidden tab and off-screen; reduced motion turns autoplay, the portrait swing and the word reveal off entirely.
